6797-7084-8347.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

4694-5231-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5231-5805-7306.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Repeat from step 1.

1309-5531-5694-6763-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1309-5531-5694-6763-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Salvager of Secrets and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Repeat.
1309-5531-5694-6763-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Salvager of Secrets and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

1479-2443-2841-6528.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-6528.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

728-7430--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gorma.
Resolve the persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

628-3899-5007.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Morselhoarder by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color
Repeat.
628-3899-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

2738-4871-5686-5687.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Skittering Precursor, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2173-2438-5220-7918.description:
Cast Carrion Feeder by paying its mana cost.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-6830-6996-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6830-6996-7810.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-4753.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-4753.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Clever Impersonator and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Clever Impersonator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-4753.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

3457-3717-7791.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Viridian Joiner.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

1376-3457-7791.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Priest of Titania.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Priest of Titania.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6595-7750.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6595-7750.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Lyse Hext's prowess ability and Medusa trigger.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Medusa trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2103-2239-7631.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Echocasting Symposium's paradigm ability triggers, causing you to cast a copy of it from exile. 
Resolve the copy, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

1362-2248-3259--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
1362-2248-3259--85--106.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

997-4681-5170-6094.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1978-4002-4694.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1978-4002-4694.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Repeat

465-5147-6132.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

957-2061-4823.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Timeless Witness.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

1062-3518-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three land cards in hand.
1062-3518-5751.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card.
Slogurk's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Slogurk's first ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Slogurk's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Slogurk's third ability triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.

215-729-2404-2930.notablePrerequisites:
Portent Tracker does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2404-2930.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Portent Tracker's first ability by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Portent Tracker any number of times.

215-4050-4555-4772-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Forests.
215-4050-4555-4772-5176.description:
Cast Tangle Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Tangle Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

751-2060-5283.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
751-2060-5283.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

147-5134.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Fated Infatuation
147-5134.description:
Cast Fated Infatuation by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fated Infatuation, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Fated Infatuation, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

2550-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Emrakul's Hatcher.
Emrakul's Hatcher enters the battlefield, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the three Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1339-1689-3923-4289.description:
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {2}{U}, causing you to draw three cards due to Eligeth and return Mystic Speculation to your hand.
The Locust God triggers three times, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate the three Insects by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Repeat.
